name: Number Input
summary: Generic native numeric field with one value owner, explicit step actions, form constraints, read-only and disabled semantics, and shared progressive stepping behavior.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Sole native numeric value, validity, form, keyboard, and reset owner.

anatomy.name: innerSpinButton
anatomy.description: Generated WebKit inner spin button hidden by the CSS adapter.

anatomy.name: outerSpinButton
anatomy.description: Generated WebKit outer spin button hidden by the CSS adapter.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state that preserves the active validation family.

states.name: buttonHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on increment or decrement buttons.

states.name: buttonDisabled
states.description: Unavailable increment or decrement button state.

states.name: focusWithin
states.description: Shared field focus hierarchy when any stepper control has focus. Variant-specific selectors are implementation coverage of this same state.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable whole-control state driven by the native field.

states.name: readOnly
states.description: Focusable and submittable value with both step actions unavailable.

states.name: spinButtonsHidden
states.description: Native WebKit spin buttons hidden by the CSS adapter.

behavior.name: nativeNumber
behavior.description: The native field preserves numeric editing, Arrow Up/Down, constraints, validity, form ownership, empty intermediate input, and reset.

behavior.name: incrementDecrement
events: ArrowUp and ArrowDown on the native field
behavior.description: Shared progressive enhancement calls native stepDown or stepUp, emits input and change only when the value changes, and preserves direct editing.

behavior.name: buttonAvailability
behavior.description: Enhancement derives boundary availability and disables both actions when the field is disabled or read-only.

behavior.name: validationComposition
behavior.description: Number Input owns control validation treatment while a composing Field Wrapper owns the visible label and feedback.

behavior.name: valueOwnership
attributes: value establishes the initial value in static HTML
live value or defaultValue in framework adapters
behavior.description: The native field is the sole numeric owner; buttons and adapters never clamp each keystroke or maintain a hidden mirror.

behavior.name: quantityReconciliation
behavior.description: Number Input shares the internal native stepping model with Quantity Selector without merging, aliasing, or deprecating either public component.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the numeric value.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Optional initial numeric value; omission allows an empty field and framework adapters may bind live value or defaultValue.

properties.name: min
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit min when the target has no lower boundary.
properties.description: Optional minimum used by native validity and derived step-action availability.

properties.name: max
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit max when the target has no upper boundary.
properties.description: Optional maximum used by native validity and derived step-action availability.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Positive increment used by native and explicit controls; absent, invalid, or non-positive values fall back to one.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes field and step controls unavailable.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native form field name used when the number participates in submission.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires a non-empty valid numeric value through native constraint validation; when a visible Field Wrapper label is composed, that label shows the standardized decorative marker.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Keeps the numeric value focusable and submittable while preventing typing and step actions.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the native numeric field; a visible composing label remains preferred.

properties.name: decrementLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the decrement action.

properties.name: incrementLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the increment action.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit aria-describedby when no external guidance or validation feedback is composed.
properties.description: Id reference for numeric guidance or validation feedback.

accessibility: Use a native number input for numeric semantics and mobile keyboard support.
Provide a visible label or equivalent accessible name.
Keep increment and decrement controls clearly named.
Respect min, max, step, disabled, and readonly constraints.
Do not rely on hidden browser spin buttons as the only way to change the value.
Preserve empty and partial direct editing instead of coercing every input event to zero or a boundary.
Use native input and change events for controlled adapters and preserve form reset behavior.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and shared progressive enhancement preserve native stepping, events, form/reset ownership, validation boundaries, and disabled/read-only synchronization without merging Quantity Selector.
